notes: Posted 31 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting...' (8): You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Heading For The Medical Frigate, The Camp, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice, Don't Do That Again and Han (imprisoned per the Objective); these count toward the 60. The Camp, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice and Don't Do That Again are the starting Effects (Effects, not Defensive Shields, in 2001); The Camp is shown as the starting effect.
Posted 'EPP Han [Imprisoned (]' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (the strategy: 'I purposely started the EPP Han imprisoned'); with 'EPP Han x2' the deck has three copies.

Posted 'Aud. Chamber' dested the Light Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber; 'Jabba's Palace' the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Moisture Farm' the Light Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm; 'Monk' B'omarr Monk; 'Artoo' Artoo (Jabba's Palace) (strategy: Artoo pulls A Gift).
Posted 'Beru & Owen' dested the Reflections II combo character Owen Lars & Beru Lars (Harvest needs Owen or Beru).

Posted 'Wise Advise/Do Or Do Not' dested Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Out of Commsion/Trans. Term.' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Sorry About the Mess/Blaster Prof.' Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; 'Nebruin Leids' Nabrun Leids; 'Leia Frees Han For Free (Someone Who Loves You)' Someone Who Loves You; Weapon Levitation the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.
Posted 'Qui-Gon's Saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III); 'Anakin' Saber' Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Ben's Saber' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Legendary Starfighter for the Jedi' is printed as written (type UNKNOWN): the strategy says it is the poster's own nickname ('as I like to call it') for an Immediate Effect with high destiny; Legendary Starfighter itself deploys on a starfighter and the deck has none.
Posted 'Grabber' is printed as written (type UNKNOWN): pre-Coruscant Light grabbers include Grappling Hook and What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?, and the post does not say which.
